title: SandpaneMaintenance
description: A9 maintenance methods (design 2026-10-09 §3.9): params and results of maintenance.inventory and maintenance.cleanup. Hand-synced with sandpane_protocol::{MaintenanceInventoryParams, MaintenanceItem, MaintenanceUnavailable, MaintenanceInventoryResult, MaintenanceCleanupParams, MaintenanceTarget, MaintenanceConfirmation, MaintenanceSkipped, MaintenanceCleanupResult}. Only syntax-checked by `make schema-lint`; the value-set drift gate does not read this file. Core cleans up only state it created itself (temp directories under <data>/tmp, migration backups beside the database, old verification output); worktrees are report-only. Neither method spawns a process. Ids are only ever looked up in Core's own fresh inventory; no path is built from a client-supplied id.

id.description: Core-assigned. Grammar: `temp:<lowercase UUID v4>`, `dbBackup:<exact backup file name>`, `verificationOutput:<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ cutoff>`, `worktree:<task id>`, or the opaque `foreign:<n>` for entries Core did not create (never removable).

kind.description: An OPEN string, deliberately not an enum: clients render an unknown kind unchecked and show `detail`.

bytes.description: Absent when Core did not measure the size. A9 measures dbBackup file sizes and verificationOutput byte counts (stdout + stderr as stored); it measures no temp or worktree sizes.

createdAt.description: The file system's birth time, where the platform reports one.

detail.description: Core-built, escaped (control characters and invalid UTF-8 replaced), at most 512 bytes. UNTRUSTED display text: foreign names are arbitrary bytes.

reason.description: Why `removable` is false. Escaped and bounded like `detail`.

path.description: Worktree items only (additive to §3.9): the worktree directory, a display-only copyable value. Never executed.

repositoryPath.description: Tracked worktree items only (additive to §3.9): the repository the worktree belongs to, a display-only copyable value.

MaintenanceUnavailable.description: A kind Core could not inventory at all, for example temp and worktree when Core runs without a data directory (additive to §3.9).

items.description: Ordered by (kind, id), so `truncated` is stable between scans.

truncated.description: True when entries were left out: more than 2000 items, or a directory with more than 10000 entries.

items.description: Inventory ids. Duplicates, ids outside the grammar, more than 500 ids, unknown or not-removable ids are VALIDATION_FAILED at step 1 (nothing issued). Step 2 must present exactly the confirmed set (order does not matter).

confirmToken.description: Absent at step 1. Step 2: the token from step 1's confirmation (256-bit, single-use, 120 s).

impact.description: Shown in the gesture-only confirmation; dbBackup items are listed on their own lines.

MaintenanceConfirmation.description: The §2 confirmation with an item-set target (not the {name, id} ConfirmationTarget of the other two-step methods).

freedBytes.description: File-system removals only, never verificationOutput. Absent when a removed item's size was not measured (every removed temp item).

notes.description: Step 2 honesty statements (additive to §3.9), e.g. that pruned verification output is removed from Sandpane's records while the database file does not shrink and older migration backups may still contain it.

MaintenanceCleanupResult.description: Step 1 answers {confirmation}; step 2 answers {removed, skipped, freedBytes?, notes?}. A partial failure is never reported as cleaned: every requested id is in exactly one of removed or skipped.
